n-k-k6-02.title: Yiziphi izinhlangano ezingangena?
n-k-k6-02.topic: Imithetho yokufunda enemikhawulo: amaqembu, izilinganiso nesabelomali
n-k-k6-02.goal: Funda isaziso sokungena esinemithetho evimbelana, wakhe amaqembu amaningana anelisa yonke imithetho ngasikhathi sinye, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani uhlobo olulodwa lweqembu lungeke lusebenze.
n-k-k6-02.material:
Iklabhu yakho ifuna ukuvakashela imyuziyamu yesayensi yezingane. Ufunda isaziso futhi unquma isabelomali.

[어린이 과학관 단체 입장 안내]
- 요금: 어른 한 명 5,000원, 어린이 한 명 3,000원
- 어린이는 어른과 함께 와야 합니다. 어른 한 명당 어린이 세 명까지 들어갈 수 있습니다.
- 단체 입장은 모두 5명 이상일 때만 가능합니다.
- 어린이가 1명 이상 있는 단체만 신청할 수 있습니다.

Isabelomali seklabhu yakho: 총 요금 25,000원 이하.
n-k-k6-02.thinking.0: Ukuguqula amagama enani esiKorea abe yizimo
n-k-k6-02.thinking.2: Ukubona ukuthi umthetho owodwa ukhawulela omunye kanjani
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.prompt: Bheka kuphela umthetho ngabadala nezingane (ungazinaki intengo nemithetho yosayizi weqembu). Imuphi uhambo OLUNGAVUNYELWANGA?
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.hint.0: Funda '어른 한 명당 어린이 세 명까지' njengomthetho osebenza kumdala ngamunye ngokwehlukile.
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.hint.1: Ngenketho ngayinye, phindaphinda inani labadala ngezingane ezivunyelwe bese uqhathanisa.
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.r.b: Kuyavunyelwa: umdala oyedwa angabeka izingane ezifika kwezintathu, futhi ezintathu ngumkhawulo uqobo.
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.r.c: Kuyavunyelwa: abadala ababili bangaletha izingane ezifika kwezithupha.
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.r.d: Kuyavunyelwa: abadala abane bangaletha izingane ezifika kwezilishumi nambili.
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.explain: Umkhawulo yizingane ezintathu KUMDALA ngamunye. Abadala ababili bangaletha izingane ezingu-6 ngokuphezulu, 2 x 3 = 6, ngakho eziyisikhombisa ziningi kakhulu.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.prompt: Akha amaqembu ahlukile angu-3 afinyelela KUYO YONKE imithetho nesabelomali. a = inani labadala, c = inani lezingane.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala izimo ezine ngamagama akho kuqala (abadala, izingane ngomdala ngamunye, abantu bonke, imali).
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha inani labadala kuqala, bese uthola ukuthi yimaphi amanani ezingane avunyelwe umthetho wesilinganiso nomthetho wabantu abangu-5.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.hint.2: Hlola imali ekugcineni: 5,000 x abadala + 3,000 x izingane.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.fail.c0: Sebenzisa amanani agcwele abantu (izingane ezingu-0 noma ngaphezulu).
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.fail.c1: 어린이는 어른과 함께 와야 합니다: okungenani umdala oyedwa.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Akukho zingane ezingaphezu kwezintathu ngomdala ngamunye.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Izingane eziningi kakhulu: ezintathu ngokuphezulu ngomdala ngamunye.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.fail.c3: 단체 입장은 5명 이상: okungenani abantu abangu-5 sekukonke.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.fail.c5: 어린이가 1명 이상 있는 단체만 신청할 수 있습니다: okungenani ingane eyodwa.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.explain: Isibonelo abadala abangu-2 + izingane ezingu-3 = 19,000 won; 3 + 2 = 21,000 won; 4 + 1 = 23,000 won. Amaqembu ayisithupha afanelana sekukonke: (2,3), (2,4), (2,5), (3,2), (3,3), (4,1). Isaziso sinikeza imikhawulo, hhayi iqembu elilodwa ncamashi.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Zama iqembu elinomdala OYEDWA ncamashi. Ngomusho owodwa noma emibili (isiNgisi noma isiKorea), chaza ukuthi kungani akukho qembu elinjalo elinganeliseka imithetho. Sebenzisa izinombolo.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Bala abantu abaningi okungenzeka ube nabo iqembu elinomdala oyedwa.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Qhathanisa leyo nombolo nomthetho wosayizi weqembu.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ngisebenzise umkhawulo wezingane ezingu-3 nobuncane babantu abangu-5 ndawonye?
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Ngomdala o-1, izingane ezingu-3 ngokuphezulu zingeza, ngakho iqembu linabantu abangu-4 kuphela, kodwa ubuncane ngu-5.

n-k-k6-05.s.s1.prompt: Funda ingxenye ngayinye, khetha ukufunda okubonakala kunokwenzeka kakhulu, bese uqhubeka.
n-k-k6-05.title: Ingabe wenze umsebenzi wasekhaya?
n-k-k6-05.topic: Ukungacaci emyalezweni: u-다 + 안 angasho u-'lutho' noma u-'hhayi sonke'
n-k-k6-05.goal: Funda ingxoxo emfushane ngezigaba, ubone ukuthi u-'ㅡ 다 안 했어요' ungasho izinto ezimbili, ubuyekeze ukufunda njengoba imininingwane ifika, bese ubhala imisho engenakungacaci.
n-k-k6-05.material: Uthisha ubuza ngomsebenzi wasekhaya. Umsebenzi wasekhaya wawunezinkinga eziyi-10.
n-k-k6-05.thinking.1: Ukubuyekeza ukufunda lapho kufika imininingwane emisha
n-k-k6-05.thinking.2: Ukubhala kabusha umyalezo ukuze ungaqondwa kabi
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.hint.0: Nquma usebenzisa kuphela lokho osukufundile kuze kube manje, futhi usho ngokuvuthayo wonke amakhonjwa umusho ongaba nawo.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.hint.1: Buza ukuthi yiziphi izincazelo ezisahambisana uma imigqa emisha isengeziwe.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Ukufunda kokubili kuyenzeka: u-'다 안 했어요' ungasho 'akenzanga lutho' noma 'akenzanga konke'. U-'죄송해요' ubonisa ukuthi okuthile kushoda, kodwa hhayi ukuthi kushoda kangakanani.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Manje u-'숙제를 다 안 했어요' washo ini?
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Imininingwane iyaqeda: izinkinga eziyi-8 kweziyi-10 zenziwe, ngakho umusho wawusho u-'hhayi konke'.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uthi wenze izinkinga zika-1 kuya ku-8.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Wenze iningi futhi waphuthelwa yizinkinga ezimbili zokugcina.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Impendulo yakhe yesibili itshela ngokunembile ukuthi yiziphi izinkinga azenzile.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yimuphi umusho u-유나 okufanele awubhale ukuze uthisha angawuthathi njengo-'wenze iningi'?
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.2.after: U-'하나도 안 했어요' awushiyi sikhala sika-'ingxenye'. U-'다는 못 했어요' yindlela ecacile yokusho u-'hhayi konke'.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Lona umusho ofanayo onezindlela ezimbili njengakuqala; awususi u-'wenze ingxenye'.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Lokhu kuzwakala njengo-'wenze ingxenye kodwa hhayi konke', okuphambene nalokho u-유나 afuna ukukusho.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Lokhu kusho ukuthi wenze cishe konke.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.reflect: Qaphela ukuthi amagama afanayo ahlala efana futhi imininingwane kuphela eshintshe ukufunda kwakho. Umkhulumi ofuna ukuqiniseka ukuthi uzoqondwa kufanele akhethe amagama avumela incazelo eyodwa kuphela.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.prompt: Yimiphi kule misho engaqondwa kabi ngendlela efanayo no-'숙제를 다 안 했어요'?
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.hint.0: Thola umusho lapho igama elisho 'bonke' lihlangana negama lokuphika.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.hint.1: Zama ukusho umusho ngamunye ucabanga ngezimo ezimbili ezihlukile bese ubona ukuthi iyiphi ehambisana nazo zombili.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.r.b: Lokhu kusho ukuthi izivakashi azikafiki; akunakho ukuhlukana kwe-'bonke noma lutho'.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.r.c: Lokhu kusho ngokucacile ukuthi akekho owafika.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.r.d: Lokhu kusho ukuthi ambalwa afika; akushiyi u-'lutho noma hhayi bonke' evulekile.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.explain: U-'다' (bonke) olandelwa ukuphika angafundwa njengo-'lutho' noma u-'hhayi bonke', ngakho u-'손님이 다 안 왔어요' unezindlela zokufunda ezifanayo ezimbili.
n-k-k6-05.s.s3.prompt: Bhala imisho emibili yesiKorea (ukukhuluma okunenhlonipho), ngamunye mayelana nomsebenzi OHLUKILE (isibonelo umsebenzi wasekhaya, ukuhlanza noma incwadi). Umusho 1: awenzanga lutho lomsebenzi wokuqala. Umusho 2: wenze ingxenye kuphela yomsebenzi wesibili. Ungasebenzisi u-'다 안' noma u-'다 못' kunoma yimuphi umusho.
n-k-k6-05.s.s3.hint.1: Kwa-'ingxenye', sho ukuthi wenze kangakanani (ingxenye, okuncane, kuze kube yilapho) noma usebenzise isimo esisho 'hhayi konke'.
n-k-k6-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe umusho ngamunye wami ungafundwa ngendlela eyodwa kuphela?
n-k-k6-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe imisho emibili ichaza ngempela amanani ahlukene?

n-k-k6-04.title: Ingabe isifinyezo sihambisana nombiko?
n-k-k6-04.topic: Ukufinyeza ucwaningo ngokwethembeka: lokho umbiko ukusekelayo
n-k-k6-04.goal: Qhathanisa isifinyezo sebhulogi somfundi naye nombiko wephephandaba lesikole, uthole imigqa umbiko ongayisekeli, bese ulungisa owodwa.
n-k-k6-04.material:
Iphephandaba lesikole lashicilela umbiko omfushane. U-하준 wawufinyeza ebhulogini lekilasi kumngani owayengakwazi ukufunda iphephandaba.

[학교 신문: 급식 설문 결과]
- 조사 대상: 6학년 2반 학생 24명 (6학년은 모두 다섯 반입니다.)
- 18명은 "급식이 맛있다", 6명은 "보통이다"라고 답했습니다. "맛없다"고 답한 학생은 없었습니다.
- 급식을 남기지 않는 학생은 14명이었습니다.
n-k-k6-04.thinking.2: Ukubhala kabusha umugqa ukuze uhambisane nobufakazi baso
n-k-k6-04.s.s1.prompt: Qhathanisa isifinyezo ka-하준 nombiko. Khetha umugqa owodwa wesifinyezo ongasekelwa ngumbiko. (Umugqa ongaphezu kowodwa awulungile.)
n-k-k6-04.s.s1.hint.0: Thatha isifinyezo umugqa nomugqa bese uthola umusho wombiko ovela kuwo.
n-k-k6-04.s.s1.hint.1: Kumugqa ngamunye, qhathanisa abafundi izinombolo zombiko ezibhekene nabo nabafundi umugqa okhuluma ngabo.
n-k-k6-04.s.s1.explain: Imigqa 2, 4 no-6 ayilungile. Umbiko ubuze kuphela abafundi abangu-24 be-6학년 2반, ngakho awusho lutho ngabo bonke abafundi bebanga lesithupha, amanye amakilasi noma sonke isikole. Imigqa 1, 3 no-5 ikhuluma ngalelo kilasi futhi ihambisana nombiko.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.prompt: Imigqa engalungile inento eyodwa efanayo. Luhlobo luni lwephutha?
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.hint.0: Kumugqa ngamunye owukhethile, sho ukuthi ngabaphi abafundi umbiko ubhekene nabo nokuthi ngabaphi abafundi umugqa ubhekene nabo.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.hint.1: Funa lokho imigqa emithathu eyabelana ngakho lapho uqhathanisa lawo maqembu amabili.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.o.b: Okwaziwa ngekilasi elilodwa kwashiwo ngeqembu elikhulu.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.r.c: Iziphetho ezingasemthethweni ziyajwayelekile esifinyezweni sasemnganini futhi akusiyo iphutha lokuqukethwe.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.r.d: Imigqa engalungile yengeza izimangalo; ayilahli imiphumela.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.explain: Umbiko umayelana nabafundi abangu-24 ekilasini elilodwa. Imigqa engalungile yelulela lowo mphumela kubo bonke abafundi bebanga lesithupha, kwamanye amakilasi, noma sonke isikole, lokho umbiko ongakaze ukusho.
n-k-k6-04.s.s3.prompt: Bhala kabusha umugqa wokugcina wesifinyezo (mayelana nokungashiyi ukudla) ukuze usho kuphela lokho umbiko ukushoyo (ukukhuluma okungasemthethweni nomngani wakho kulungile).
n-k-k6-04.s.s3.hint.0: Thola umusho wombiko lo mugqa ovela kuwo bese uphawula ngqo ukuthi uqamba bani nokuthi bangaki.
n-k-k6-04.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala kabusha umugqa usebenzisa leli qembu nalelo nombolo kuphela.
n-k-k6-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe umugqa wami uqamba iqembu umbiko olibuzile?
n-k-k6-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ngigcine inombolo njengoba umbiko uyinikeza, ngaphandle kokuyiguqula ibe ngu-'most' noma u-'all'?

n-k-k6-01.title: Ukufunda izinombolo zomtapo wezincwadi
n-k-k6-01.topic: Ukuhlola izimangalo nobufakazi: lokho ithebula lezinombolo elingakubonisa
n-k-k6-01.goal: Nquma ukuthi yimiphi imisho ithebula elincane lezinombolo zomtapo wezincwadi elisekela ngempela, uthole igebe phakathi kwesihloko seposta nethebula, bese ukuchaza ngenombolo.
n-k-k6-01.material:
Umtapo wezincwadi wendawo ubeke ithebula neposta.

n-k-k6-01.thinking.0: Ukuhlukanisa lokho ithebula elikubalayo nalokho isimangalo sikushoyo
n-k-k6-01.prereq.1: Wazi 늘다 / 줄다 kanye ne-작년 / 올해
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.prompt: Yimiphi imisho ithebula ngokwalo elisekela yona, ngaphandle kokuqagela? Khetha yonke efanele.
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.hint.0: Maka isitatimende ngasinye 'inombolo engingakhomba kuyo' noma 'okuthile okumele ngikuqagele'.
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ngezitatimende ngezinombolo, thola izibalo ezimbili bese uziqhathanisa ngohlangothi olufanele.
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.r.a: Ukuthanda izincwadi kungumuzwa; ithebula libala ukuvakasha nezincwadi ezibolekiwe, hhayi imizwa.
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.r.c: Phinda uqhathanise 5,200 no-5,100: inani lezincwadi ezibolekiwe lihambe ngenye indlela.
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.r.d: Ithebula lilaza igumbi lokufunda njengenothi eliseceleni kuphela; alibonisi ukuthi igumbi lingumsuka wokukhuphuka.
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.explain: Ithebula libonisa izivakashi ezingu-2,400 kuya ku-3,000 (ngaphezulu) nezincwadi ezibolekiwe ezingu-5,200 kuya ku-5,100 (ezimbalwa kancane). Imizwa nezizathu aziyikho ethebuleni, futhi 'izincwadi eziningi' iphambene nalokho elikubonisayo.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.prompt: Liyini igebe eliyinhloko phakathi kwesihloko seposta nethebula?
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.hint.0: Gcizelela isenzo esihlokweni seposta, bese uthola umugqa ethebuleni olinganisa into efanayo.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa lokho umugqa ngamunye wethebula ukubalayo nalokho isihloko sisho ukuthi abantu bakwenzile.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.o.a: Iposta ikhuluma ngonyaka odlule, kodwa ithebula libonisa kuphela walo nyaka.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.r.a: Ithebula linekholomu yonyaka odlule neyalo nyaka zombili.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.o.b: Iposta isho ukuthi abantu bafunda kakhulu, kodwa ithebula libonisa izivakashi ezimbalwa.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.r.b: Ithebula libonisa izivakashi eziningi, hhayi ezimbalwa.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.o.c: Iposta ilungile, ngoba umtapo wezincwadi onomsindo usho ukufunda okuningi.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.r.c: Izivakashi eziningi akufani nokufunda okuningi: abantu bangaza ngezinye izizathu, futhi inani lokuboleka alikhulanga.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.o.d: Iposta ikhuluma ngokufunda, kodwa ithebula libala ukuvakasha nokuboleka, futhi ukuboleka akukhuphukanga.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.explain: 'Ukufunda kakhulu' akusona into ithebula elisibalayo. Isilinganiso esiseduze izincwadi ezibolekiwe, futhi azikhuphukanga. Izivakashi eziningi zingaba umphumela wegumbi lokufunda elisha, kodwa ithebula alikwazi ukusho.
n-k-k6-01.s.s3.prompt: Emishweni engu-1-2 (isiNgisi noma isiKorea), sho ukuthi ithebula lisekela isihloko seposta yini nokuthi kungani. Sebenzisa okungenani inombolo eyodwa evela ethebuleni.
n-k-k6-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qamba umugqa wethebula osondele kakhulu ku-'ukufunda', unikeze izinombolo zawo ezimbili.
n-k-k6-01.s.s3.hint.1: Bese usho lokho lowo mugqa OKUNGAKUBONISI mayelana nesihloko seposta.
n-k-k6-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngishilo ukuthi ithebula libala ini nokuthi iposta isho ini?
n-k-k6-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Inombolo yami ibekwe lapho isebenza njengobufakazi, hhayi ukukopishwa nje?
n-k-k6-01.s.s3.model.0: Ithebula libonisa izivakashi eziningi (2,400 kuya ku-3,000), kodwa izincwadi ezibolekiwe zehle kusuka ku-5,200 kuya ku-5,100, ngakho alibonisi ukuthi abantu bafunda kakhulu.

n-k-k6-03.s.s1.prompt: Uma ulandela uhlelo luka-민아 futhi usebenzisa le coupon eyodwa ama-Americano amabili ngoLwesine, yisiphi isitatimende esiyiqiniso?
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola inketho ngayinye ngokumelene nemigqa ebhaliwe ye-coupon: yiziphi ongaziqinisekisa futhi yiziphi ongaziphikisa?
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.hint.1: Sebenza ukuthi uhlelo lungabiza malini nge-coupon nangaphandle kwayo, usebenzisa kuphela lokho i-coupon ekushoyo.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.o.a: I-coupon iphelelwe yisikhathi ngoLwesine, ngakho akukho zaphulelo.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.r.a: ULwesine ngu-April 30, futhi u-'4월 30일까지' ufaka lolo suku.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.o.b: I-coupon isusa u-2,000 won kuphuzo ngalunye, ngakho u-4,000 sekukonke.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.r.b: U-'1회 사용' usho ukusetshenziswa okukodwa nge-coupon ngayinye, hhayi ukusetshenziswa okukodwa ngophuzo ngalunye.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.o.c: Ukwengeza esinye isaphulelo kwenza ukonga kube kukhulu kuno-2,000 won.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.r.c: U-'다른 할인과 중복 불가' usho ukuthi izaphulelo azikwazi ukuhlanganiswa.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.o.d: I-coupon eyodwa isusa u-2,000 won kanye, hhayi u-4,000.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.explain: Namuhla nguMsombuluko umhla ka-27, ngakho uLwesine umhla ka-30, usuku lokugcina olusebenzayo. I-coupon yokusetshenziswa kanye futhi ayikwazi ukuhlanganiswa, ngakho iziphuzo ezimbili zisathola u-2,000 won sekukonke.
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.prompt: Uhlelo ngoLwesine cishe ngo-3 p.m. e-café phambi kwesikole. Yimuphi umbuzo ongaphenduliwe yi-coupon futhi ongasayimisa uhlelo?
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.hint.0: Kumbuzo ngamunye, funa umugqa we-coupon oyiphendulayo; susa lezo ongazibuza.
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.hint.1: Iyiphi ingxenye yohlelo engagoqwanga muphi umugqa obhaliwe?
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.r.a: I-coupon isivele inikeza usuku lokugcina olusebenzayo, futhi uLwesine uyahambisana.
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.r.b: I-coupon isivele isho ukuthi isetshenziswa kanye nge-coupon.
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.r.d: I-coupon isivele isho ukuthi isebenza kuwo wonke amagatsha e-모아카페.
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.explain: Usuku, inani lokusetshenziswa namagatsha kubhalwe ku-coupon. Umugqa wokugcina ushiya 'eminye imibandela' ivulekile, futhi isikhathi sosuku siyiyodwa engabalulekile ekuvakasheni ngo-3 p.m.
n-k-k6-03.s.s3.prompt: Phendula u-민아 ngesiKorea (isitayela sobungane se-해요체). Lungisa ngobumnene umbono we-4,000 won, bese ucela noma uphakamise ukuhlola umbuzo ovulekile.
n-k-k6-03.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala izingxenye ezimbili ezimfushane: lokho okwaziyo ku-coupon, bese lokho ofuna ukukuthola.
n-k-k6-03.s.s3.hint.1: Sebenzisa isiphetho esiphakamisayo noma esibuzayo, esifana no-'-(으)ㄹ까요?'.
n-k-k6-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ngisho ukuthi i-coupon inikeza ini ngempela (isaphulelo esisodwa sika-2,000 won)?
n-k-k6-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe umbuzo wami umayelana nento eyodwa i-coupon engayishongo?
